info.title: review-md x-callback URL API
info.description:
Drive the review-md Obsidian plugin from other apps and agents via `obsidian://review-md-<operation>?...` URLs. Each operation is its own Obsidian action (URL endpoint) and follows the x-callback-url convention: pass `x-success`/`x-error` URLs to be opened when the operation finishes. Parameter values are URL-encoded strings. The `vault` parameter is required in the URL so Obsidian routes to the right vault window; the plugin itself resolves `file` against the active vault.

**Not an HTTP API.** These are Obsidian custom-scheme URLs; each "path" below is an Obsidian action (`obsidian://<action>`) and every parameter is passed in the query string. Invoke a URL by opening it (e.g. `open '<url>'` on macOS, or `xdg-open` on Linux). Note: Obsidian reserves `vault` (used to route to the vault window) — it is required in the URL but is not delivered to the plugin.

get.summary: Open a file in the reviewer
get.description:
Open a markdown file in the review-md reviewer and, optionally, scroll to a specific comment thread.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-open?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-open?vault=docs&file=designs%2Fdesign.md`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file to open.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread id (the file's `^blockId`) to scroll to after opening.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation succeeds (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.

get.description:
Append a message to an existing comment thread stored in the file's frontmatter, then open the file at that thread.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-reply?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-reply?vault=docs&file=designs%2Fdesign.md&thread=d1a2b3&body=agreed%20%E2%80%94%20let's%20keep%20it%20in%20frontmatter`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file that holds the thread.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Id of the thread to reply to.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The reply text. URL-encode newlines and special characters.
parameters.example: agreed — let's keep it in frontmatter

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name recorded on the reply.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened when the reply is stored (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the reply fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.

get.description:
Mark a comment thread resolved (the default) or open again. Use it after answering a thread, so answered threads don't pile up as open.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-resolve?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-resolve?vault=docs&file=designs%2Fdesign.md&thread=d1a2b3`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file that holds the thread.

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Id of the thread to resolve or reopen.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: `resolved` closes the thread; `open` reopens it.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened once the thread's state is stored (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.

get.description:
Start a new comment thread on a passage (found by `quote`), a diagram box (`node`), or an arrow (`from` + `to`). Pass exactly one target. A passage gets a `^id` written into the doc, as when a reviewer comments by hand.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-comment?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-comment?vault=docs&file=designs%2Fdesign.md&body=This%20step%20needs%20a%20timeout.`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path to the markdown file to comment on.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The first message of the thread.

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Words from the passage or heading to comment on (the first passage containing them, case-insensitive).

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Id of a mermaid diagram box to comment on.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start box id of a mermaid arrow to comment on (with `to`).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End box id of a mermaid arrow to comment on (with `from`).

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name recorded on the first message.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened once the thread is stored (x-callback-url).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the operation fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.

get.summary: Copy threads to the clipboard for an AI tool
get.description:
Gather comment threads — from one file, or every file in the vault — into a Markdown digest (anchor, state, messages, and an open/reply link per thread) and copy it to the clipboard, ready to paste into any AI chat. Open threads only unless `resolved=include`. The same digest `npm run reviews -- list` prints from a clone.

Invoke as: `obsidian://review-md-export?…`

Example: `obsidian://review-md-export?vault=docs`

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Name of the target Obsidian vault. Consumed by Obsidian to route to the vault window (required in the URL, but not delivered to the plugin).

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Vault-relative path of one file to export. Omit to export every file with comments.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Only threads whose messages, authors or anchor contain this text (case-insensitive — the same match as the panel's search box).

parameters.name: resolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads are included.

parameters.name: x-success
parameters.description: URL opened once the digest is on the clipboard (x-callback-url). The digest comes back on it too, for callers that can't read the clipboard: `count` (threads), `digest` (the Markdown, cut at 30,000 characters) and `truncated` (`true` when it was cut — read the clipboard instead).

parameters.name: x-error
parameters.description: URL opened when the export fails (x-callback-url).

200.description: Success. If `x-success` was supplied, that URL is opened.

400.description: Missing or invalid parameters. If `x-error` was supplied, that URL is opened.
